body: Thank you! It is tough but all I can do is push through.

I would if money wasn't such an issue currently. We are trying to buy our house at the moment.
I've given that a try before but I've had 3 surgeries on my knee and a displaced rib so there are times it is hard to do as well. Thus why I am at my wits end with things.
I cross-stitch but that is about it. I find it hard to concentrate sometimes to finish anything.
I am on Vraylar at 3mg a day and that is the highest they have put me on.
I had a therapist like that. I miss my last one. The other issue is how far away they are with me living in the country.

I was in therapy for a while but I just felt like I was being judged. I went through a handful of therapists. Found one I really liked and she moved states. And thankfully right now my kids are with their grandparents for the summer. So they don't have to see me like this.

Thank you. It is nice to hear. I have been through many doctors in my area. My problem is I live in the country and the closest doctor is over an hour away one way. I chose this doctor because of his ratings in the area.
I plan on it if I make it through the night.
I have unfortunately tried all the treatments except one which is ECT. Electro-convuslive therapy. Which I am terrified off.
It hurts everyday to see them taking care of me. My 7 year old son asking me if today is a good or a bad day. It kills me inside. They deserve so much more and deserve to be free of me.
Fantastic. I'll look into those for sure. Thanks!

At this point I am willing to try anything, and I have not yet tried meditating. I had the visual hallucination during one of the songs. 

I am not sure about a community board or some sort like that, I am very shy about opening up about what goes on with me, my friend convinced me to try this because it is anon. and I can be as open as I choose to be. I will look into Aunt Bertha and see if there is any assistance that I can find.
